name: mnemon
description: Research oracle: an agent that holds large documentation or an external repo in its own context and answers your follow-up questions with citations, optionally scoped by a graphify graph

interface.shortDescription: Research oracle for documentation and external repos
interface.longDescription: Brief an agent to read a large body of documentation or another project's source into its own context, keep it available, and ask it follow-up questions — it answers with URL / path:line citations while your context stays clean. Broad repo reading can be scoped by a graphify graph.
defaultPrompt: Study the <product> API docs and keep them on tap for follow-ups.
